items.title: Josh Brown: Netflix Can Clear Wall Street’s 10.6% Growth Bar “Standing on Their Head”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysJosh Brown says Netflix can easily beat Wall Street’s 2027 revenue growth estimate, which sits below the 13% growth Netflix guides for 2026. At about 17x forward earnings, Netflix trades at roughly half its five-year average multiple, about Disney’s.

items.title: Fixing Netflix's Growing Subscriber Satisfaction Problem
items.summary: The likelihood of users recommending Netflix or Net Promoter Score is now +51 vs. +53 a year ago, according to Worldpanel by Numerator, a consumer and shopper behavior researcher.
